connector.name: Dir MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for working with OASF agent records in the Agntcy Directory.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image dir-mcp:1.3.4. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the agntcy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
